photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 09:15:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1146 s; on-screen clock 04/10/13 09:15:50, wanted 09:15:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT 13-099 9:15' on 2013-04-09 (`as run matrix!B91`), read as 2013-04-09 09:15. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-09 plus one day, 09:15: it was found 1096 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (44, 62) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('62, 44', `as run matrix!J91`).
